rejected_rule.statement: Section 111(1)(c) of the Trusts Ordinance (Cap. 72, Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) applies to Buddhist Temporalities and precludes claims being barred or prejudiced by provisions of the Prescription Ordinance.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "I hold that the learned Judge was wrong in finding that section 111 (1) (c) of the Trusts Ordinance had no application to Buddhist Temporalities."
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 111. (1) In the following cases, that is to say- (a) .... (b) .... (c) in the case of any claim in the interests of any charitable trust, for the recovery of any property comprised in the trust, or for the assertion of title to such property, the claim shall not be held to be barred or prejudiced by any provision of the Prescription Ordinance.

meta.parties: Sobitha Thera v. Wimalabuddhi Thera Et Al
